the effects of cyclohexamide on the hepatic cell.
the effects of cyclohexamide on the liver of rats exposed to carcinogens.

the effects of carcinogens on the fine structure of liver cells, and with the possibility of using these effects as a basis for the development of a model for the study of the early events of carcinogenesis.
